summary: This Phase 2 clinical trial studied the drug tirzepatide in adults who have obesity and methamphetamine use disorder, a condition where a person has trouble stopping the use of methamphetamine. The study looked at how participants used methamphetamine while taking the study drug. University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center sponsored this trial, which has a status of Completed and included 35 participants.

facts.sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
